description: This Java class defines an Android activity named 'Link' that demonstrates various methods of creating and handling hyperlinks in TextView widgets, including autoLink properties, HTML-based links, and manually styled spans with clickable URLs.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating different ways of creating clickable links within TextView widgets.

methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layouts, and configures TextViews with various hyperlink styles and behaviors.
